x: It is very pleasing to record that since our last issue we have enrolled two new walkers, and there are two or three more in the offing. Norman Dyne, of "A" Division Police, is quite a youngster and will help to build up our post-war Junior team.

During the last few weeks two new walkers have joined the Club: Norman Dyne, a young policeman who has already appeared in several " Opens." We expect big things from him, remembering past champions the police force have supplied us.
Our new members have already been giving good accounts of themselves in the Open handicaps, Norman Dyne getting a 1st and 2nd in the Highgate and Police Opens respectively, and J.
Norman Dyne, Frank Halls and others. As far as conditions would permit, our Service members came from all parts of the country to help build up the teams.
